title: Unparseable or missing goal values silently become 0
evidence: BrazilianSoccerMcp/DataLoader.cs:30-37 — ParseInt returns 0 on parse failure, so a row with a missing score is stored as a 0-0 result and counted in W/L/D and goal aggregates
suggestion: Skip rows whose goal fields fail to parse, or track them as unknown-score matches excluded from stats

title: Team matching is substring-based and can over-match similarly named clubs
evidence: BrazilianSoccerMcp/DataLoader.cs:228-234 — TeamMatches uses Contains, so a search for 'América' or 'Santos' aggregates every club containing that substring into one team's stats
suggestion: Prefer exact match on the normalized name, falling back to substring only when exact yields nothing

title: 'Seasons covered' line in get_competition_summary has an inverted condition
evidence: BrazilianSoccerMcp/SoccerTools.cs:270-274 — the distinct-seasons list is printed only when season.HasValue (when it is trivially the single filtered season) and omitted in the all-seasons case where it would be informative
suggestion: Print the seasons-covered line when no season filter is given

title: Enhancements beyond spec
evidence: BrazilianSoccerMcp/SoccerTools.cs:235-409 — get_competition_summary, get_team_competitions, get_season_list, get_top_teams exceed the required capability list; TeamStats exposes computed Points/WinRate/GoalDiff (Models.cs:58-60)
suggestion: None — positive signal for cross-run comparison
